$comment: The web-quality gate's limits and its approved exceptions (.claude/skills/web-quality/SKILL.md). Every exception names one check, one rule and the narrowest page pattern (a regex over the dist path, e.g. ^[^/]+/index\.html$ for topic pages), with a reason. An exception that no longer matches anything fails the gate, so the list only shrinks unless someone adds to it in review.

budgets.$comment: Gzipped bytes per page: inline and bundled script, CSS, and the HTML document itself.

overrides.reason: Topic pages render every claim card (up to ~660, each with its full Tailwind class list) into one document: 3-4.5 MB raw, ~520 KB gzipped on 2026-10-24. Ratchet ceiling, not a target: slimming the card markup or paginating the claims tab would bring it under the default.

thirdParty.reason: Brand type (Libre Baskerville, IBM Plex) per brand/design.md; the stylesheet.
Brand type: the font files the Google Fonts stylesheet loads.

exceptions.reason: WCAG 4.1.2, open since 2026-10-24: ClaimCard and SourceDetails put the stat-line shortcut buttons (data-pick) inside <summary>, itself a control. Fixing it means moving the chips out of the summary, a component restructure.
